title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform 2.5 Product Security and Bug Fix Update
description: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform 2.5 includes a security fix for an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Google Brotli decoder library used by python3.12-brotli (CVE-2026-111497). This vulnerability could potentially lead to memory corruption. Red Hat has released updated packages for multiple architectures and operating system versions to address this issue.
